🎥🎬: Futurama (1999–Present)

Life in the year 3000 is nothing like Fry imagined. After waking up a thousand years after his own time, he discovers a world filled with intelligent robots, alien species, bizarre inventions, and space travel that has become part of everyday life. With nowhere else to go, Fry finds a new home among the eccentric employees of Planet Express.

Alongside Leela and his troublemaking robot best friend Bender, Fry travels across the universe delivering packages to places most people would never dare visit. Their missions regularly spiral into ridiculous situations involving dangerous aliens, strange dimensions, futuristic technology, and threats that somehow put the entire crew in danger.

No matter how chaotic the future becomes, the Planet Express crew keeps finding their way back to one another, turning their wild adventures into a story about friendship, belonging, and finding your place in an unpredictable universe.

Stream an all-new season of Futurama August 3 on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.

source_details.synopsis: Futurama is an American animated science fiction sitcom created by Matt Groening and developed by Groening and David X. Cohen for the Fox Broadcasting Company, and later revived by Comedy Central and then Hulu. The series follows Philip J. Fry, a young man who is cryogenically preserved for 1,000 years and revived on December 31, 2999. Fry finds work at the interplanetary delivery company Planet Express, working alongside the one-eyed mutant Leela and the robot Bender. The series was envisioned by Groening in the mid-1990s while working on The Simpsons; he brought Cohen, a Simpsons writer, aboard to develop storylines and characters to pitch the show to Fox.
